subject: gk
question: Which of the following is an example of subsistence crop of Uttar Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wheat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Wheat** is one of the primary subsistence crops grown in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Subsistence crops are those grown primarily for the consumption of the farmer's family rather than for sale or trade.
 
• Uttar Pradesh is one of the leading states in India in the production of wheat.
 
• Wheat is a staple food in many parts of India and provides essential nutrition to the population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jute**

 
 
• Jute is a long, soft, shiny vegetable fiber that can be spun into coarse, strong threads.
 
• It is primarily grown in West Bengal, Bihar, and Assam, not Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Jute is mainly used for making gunny bags, ropes, and other industrial products.
 
 
 
• **Cotton**
 
 
• Cotton is a soft, fluffy staple fiber that grows in a boll around the seeds of cotton plants.
 
• It is primarily grown in states like Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Punjab, not Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Cotton is used in the textile industry for making clothes.
 
 
 
• **Sugarcane**
 
 
• Sugarcane is a tropical, perennial grass that is used to produce sugar.
 
• It is a major commercial crop in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Unlike subsistence crops, sugarcane is grown primarily for sale and processing into sugar and other products.
